prompt: Organize my ~/Downloads folder into logical subfolders as follows: Move all PDF, DOCX, and TXT files into a new folder named 'Documents'; move all JPG and PNG image files into 'Images'; move all installer files (DMG, PKG) into 'Installers'. Additionally, archive any files not modified in the last 4 months by moving them into an 'Archive' folder inside Downloads. Maintain original file modification dates, handle filename conflicts by appending a numeric suffix, and do NOT delete any files. After organization, provide an "Organization Plan" summary in Markdown format saved as 'organization-plan.md' in the Downloads directory. This summary must include: current file count, breakdown by file types, proposed folder structure, list of files moved to each folder, and archive details. Output the summary exactly as Markdown text to 'organization-plan.md'.
